title: Tron 2.0 - Killer App
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Health, energy
You play Jet Bradley inside the digital world; health and energy bars
The cartridge also contains the original Bally Midway Tron arcade game (from the ROM's text)

rows: thrown weapon that returns; other programs act as weapon upgrades
steer so rivals hit your light wall
four sub-games: Tank, Light Cycles, I/O Tower and MCP cone
every enemy tank takes 3 hits (100, 300, 500 points)
touching a wall or a light trail destroys your cycle; box the yellow cycles in
break the blocks with the disc; 1000 bonus for entering the cone, 1000 for clearing all blocks

widgets.text:
Grid levels
Levels are locations on the Grid and inside computer systems

rows: pick a coloured area of the game grid; a cleared area stays closed until all four are done

widgets.text:
Programs and upgrades
Programs (weapons and abilities) are found and upgraded during levels

rows: enter before the timer ends; the time left becomes your bonus

widgets.text:
Hidden items
Arcade Tron keeps a high-score table (top 100 rankings)

Levels cleared
Story levels in order; the arcade game is a bonus from the menu
